reason: The hypothesis directly transfers the strategy of adding a fifth element (Hf) to suppress Cr-V precipitation from P4/P5/P9, but substitutes Zr for Hf based on Zr's known effects on lattice distortion and sintering from P23/P33 and P10/P15/P40. This is a straightforward element substitution in a known design framework, combining two well-established ideas (precipitation suppression by alloying and sintering enhancement by Ti/Zr) without a new mechanistic link or resolution of a conflict. The core idea is a minor variation on existing work.
